facets.authority: Register read requires clinical.observations.viewAny. Module creation requires clinical.observations.record, separately authorized Client view, and clinical.observations.recordClinical additionally for vitals or pain.
facets.site_direct_object: Register rows, filters, and options use approved-Site scope. Foreign Client, Site filter, or protocol schedule produces explicit 403, not concealed 404. Stored non-null Site provenance must agree with canonical Client Site. All-Sites permission broadens Site scope only.
facets.state_read_effects: The register filters by Client, type, recorder, Site, and date. Typed creation stores recorder, time, Site, data, NEWS2, flags, notes, and optional schedule provenance; it emits timeline evidence and may complete a pending schedule and emit deterioration signals.
facets.audit_provenance: ClinicalObservation uses AuditableChanges and stores recorder, Site, time, flag, and schedule provenance. Timeline creation is inside the transaction. No fail-closed audit or durable observation outbox is established.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: A three-attempt transaction owns observation, timeline, optional schedule completion, signals, and dispatch. Protocol then schedule locks serialize the supplied schedule path. Ordinary creation has no request key, general row lock, or same-result replay.
collisions_gaps: Amendment is a separate absent facet.
Questionnaire, approval, and escalation workflows are excluded.
Direct-object denial is 403.
General replay and exactly-once dispatch are not established.
Tests are source locators only and were not executed.

facets.authority: A clinical.observations.correct policy capability exists, but no routed observation amendment, correction submission, approval, rejection, or review command exists at the pin.
facets.site_direct_object: No amendment direct-object or Site behavior exists because no production action resolves an original observation or correction.
facets.state_read_effects: The model and schema expose correction_of_id, correction_status, correction_reason, approver, and approval-time fields and relationships. The canonical service only creates an initial observation and does not populate an amendment lifecycle.
facets.audit_provenance: AuditableChanges exists on the model, but model hooks cannot establish amendment provenance without a production writer.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: No amendment transaction, original-row lock, version precondition, request key, or replay contract exists.
collisions_gaps: Medication-administration correction and Behaviour ABC correction behavior belong to different owners.
Schema, relationships, permission seeding, and a policy method do not constitute an implemented amendment action.

facets.authority: Only the existing observation register and record capabilities apply. No care-context, form-template, or hierarchy-selection action capability exists in the bounded source.
facets.site_direct_object: Existing Client, Site, staff, and record scopes are approved-Site scoped, but there is no care-context or template direct object to authorize or conceal.
facets.state_read_effects: The register exposes Client, observation-type, recorder, Site, and date filters. Creation uses seven fixed ObservationType enum values and a static wizard. No care-context-dependent template catalogue, parent-child hierarchy, or hierarchy filter is present.
facets.audit_provenance: No template-selection or care-context decision exists to audit. Observation audit evidence belongs only to the resulting create command.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: The register is read-only and the requested behavior is absent; no template transaction, lock, or replay contract exists.
collisions_gaps: A protocol_schedule_id binds an optional due protocol schedule and is not a form-template hierarchy.
The wizard step labelled Context contains time, notes, and flags and is not a governed care-context object.

facets.authority: Register read requires clinical.events.viewAny. Initial creation requires clinical.events.record and separately authorized Client view. Review, follow-up, and escalation use different capabilities and are excluded.
facets.site_direct_object: Client and register filters are approved-Site scoped. Client/Shift Site conflict is rejected and the canonical Site is snapshotted. Foreign Client or Site access produces explicit 403, not concealed 404.
facets.state_read_effects: Creates an open event with reporter, type, severity, occurrence/report times, description, immediate action, outcome, witnesses, follow-up evidence, and Site. Timeline and required H&S linkage are created in the core transaction; attachments are persisted afterward. Signals and ClinicalEventRecorded dispatch occur after the transaction.
facets.audit_provenance: ClinicalEvent uses AuditableChanges and stores reporter, Site, time, linkage, and review-related fields. Initial timeline evidence is transactional, but attachments and post-transaction signals are separate boundaries.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: The core event, timeline, and required H&S linkage use a three-attempt transaction. No create row lock, request key, or same-result replay exists. Attachment/core atomicity and exactly-once post-transaction dispatch are not established.
collisions_gaps: Review, follow-up, escalation, linked-incident closure, and later investigation are excluded.
Direct-object denial is 403.
Tests are source locators only and were not executed.

facets.authority: The route and policy require incidents.approve and submitted state. Review notes are optional.
facets.site_direct_object: Neither ClientIncidentPolicy::review nor the review controller performs an approved-Site assertion before or after locking. A submitted direct-bound incident is therefore authorized by action capability and state without a Site boundary. Concealment is not established.
facets.state_read_effects: Transitions submitted to reviewed, recording reviewer, time, and optional notes. It ensures the canonical incident journey, which may create or repair linked H&S and alert records, then sends a notification after the transaction.
facets.audit_provenance: Reviewer/time/notes and ClientIncident AuditableChanges exist. No dedicated durable review outbox exists; the notification is outside the transaction.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: A three-attempt transaction locks the incident and re-authorizes the locked state. Competing review transitions serialize, but repeat review is rejected by state rather than returning the original result. No request key exists.
collisions_gaps: Investigation, root cause, corrective actions, H&S governance, and closure remain separate owners.
The missing Site assertion is a direct source gap.
Review notification durability and exactly-once delivery are not established.
Tests are source locators only and were not executed.

facets.authority: The route and policy require incidents.approve and reviewed state. closed_outcome is required; closed_notes is optional. healthSafety.viewAllSites or reports.viewAny may broaden Site scope but do not replace incidents.approve.
facets.site_direct_object: Site access is asserted before and under the incident lock. Foreign-Site denial is explicit 403, not concealed 404. A malformed or conflicting canonical journey is converted to 404.
facets.state_read_effects: Closure requires review actor/time evidence, no incomplete follow-ups, completed required high/critical investigation, and closed linked H&S governance. It transitions reviewed to closed with closer, time, outcome, notes, and a lifecycle signal outbox.
facets.audit_provenance: ClientIncident stores closure actor/time/outcome/notes and uses AuditableChanges. The same transaction records an append-only lifecycle signal containing actor, Client, Site, H&S tuple, sequence, fingerprint, and idempotency key plus a recoverable outbox. Database triggers make lifecycle signals immutable.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: A three-attempt transaction locks the parent incident, canonicalizes and locks journey parents, evaluates the gate, writes closure, locks the latest lifecycle signal, and writes the outbox. Repeat close is state-rejected rather than same-result replay. Outbox dispatch is recoverable; the separate CRUD notification has no exactly-once contract.
collisions_gaps: Investigation, follow-ups, corrective actions, H&S governance, and Control Room processing are external prerequisites, not incident-closure ownership.
Foreign-Site denial is 403.
No caller request key or same-result close replay exists.
Tests are source locators only and were not executed.

facets.authority: medications.orders.manage at the route; witness permission is checked separately.

facets.transaction_locking_replay: Writes are not transaction-bound and take no stock or register lock. The optional seven-day cache key is not actor- or payload-bound, is checked before access, and is written after effects without an atomic mutex.

Nullable medication resolution permits a register entry without medication identity, stock mutation, or schedule update.

facets.authority: medications.orders.manage plus witness permission; actor Site checks are absent.
facets.site_direct_object: The actor-Site seam is missing as for register movement, and medication lookup is nullable rather than ownership-bound.
facets.state_read_effects: The balance-check entry may carry a null client_medication_id, and stock mutation occurs only when medication resolves. On a mismatch with unmatched medication, discrepancy integration dereferences the missing medication, so discrepancy, incident, and alert effects are not unconditional and may fail.

collisions_gaps: A concurrent stock writer can race the unlocked balance transaction.
An unmatched medication plus discrepancy can fail during missing-medication dereference instead of completing discrepancy, incident, and alert creation.

facets.authority: finance.bank.manage at the route envelope.
